payload.name: PreserveExplicitMediaFactsDuringExtraction
payload.description: Use during construction extraction when a message states a concrete fact about a shared photo, video, or other media (e.g., location, date, subject) while also containing general commentary; preserve the factual detail explicitly.
content: During extraction, if a message contains a concrete fact about shared media (e.g., where or when a photo was taken, who is in it), create a candidate that states that fact directly; do not let a broader discussion/theme candidate replace it.
When a message mixes factual detail with reflective commentary, store the factual claim separately from any general theme; both may be valid memories, but the fact must not be omitted.
Before accepting an ADD candidate, check that every directly stated factual detail that could answer a future question is retained; a candidate that only restates the topic is incomplete.

solves: Concrete factual details about shared media (e.g., a photo's location) are often lost when extraction creates only a general discussion memory. This rule requires preserving such explicit facts as standalone candidates whenever a message mixes a factual statement with commentary. Applies to any media-related fact (location, time, subject); not to purely opinion/theme summaries.
